comparison: Three requested runs, each latest checkpoint frozen before first replay. Six fresh original interactive_rollout replays; no external correction; no reward, policy, gains or training edits.
decision_rule: First check no fall and traverse common stairs. Compare zero-command drift, world-axis and initial-heading path error, flat roll/pitch and diagonal load; preserve quiet using both per-event velocity/energy/40ms force peaks and cumulative energy per meter plus event counts. No invented scalar ranking; if metrics conflict state tradeoffs. Only empirical start-point recommendation, not whole-terrain or real-robot certification.
instrument_positive_negative_checks: Existing energy/force recomputation assertions cross-check arrays; zero/W command manifests must match [0,0,0]/[0.7,0,0]; false labels and changed hashes fail. Both absent-event/fall handling and event-window force calculation checked independently.
scope: Fresh diagnosis only; original policy/control/rewards untouched. zero, forward, flat stop. No corrective yaw feedback.
diagnostic_rules: Original fall rule unchanged. Report stationary drift/roll/load; route yaw/side offset; contact timing and touchdown speeds with video inspection. Contact transitions alone do not prove harmful chatter; mean balanced load cannot exclude instantaneous instability. No claim of repair or whole-course acceptance.

acceptance.note: Engineering targets chosen before candidate evaluation; same original fall rule and 36s duration. Passing one geometry/heading is only this fixed regression, not full terrain certification.
